Service.Record calls the new CheckLocations only after Parse succeeds, and wraps the error in ReplyRefusedError. Parse is unchanged, so stored results still read.
ErrInvalidLocation is added to shapeRefusals in launch.go, which is what triggers the single re-ask in review launch.
The regex rejects a bare path, a symbol after the colon, line 0, an open range, an empty path and an empty string. It accepts a path containing spaces or colons.
The new tests cover the rule at four levels: rules_test.go, record_test.go, launch_test.go, review_test.go and review_check_test.go.
The usage, README and usage.sh changes match the new behaviour.
